text: Presented “A Riemann Problem in Multicomponent Two-Phase Mixtures” at HYP2026 in Stuttgart, Germany.

Published “Solving the UVN-Flash Problem in TVN-Space” in Fluid Phase Equilibria.
Published “A New Temperature Evolution Equation That Enforces Thermodynamic Vapour–Liquid Equilibrium in Multiphase Flows — Application to CO₂ Modelling” in Computers & Fluids.
